meta.name: paid-ads-creative
meta.description: Create grounded paid-media creative concepts, copy angles, refresh hypotheses, and measurable test briefs across advertising platforms. Use for ad copy, creative briefs, UGC concepts, headlines, creative fatigue, asset ideas, or a creative refresh.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 产出广告创意文案与可测的优化方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在管理付费广告,需要持续产出新创意来对抗素材疲劳。
copy.tagline_en: Produce ad creative copy and measurable optimization briefs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run paid media and need fresh ad creative to fight fatigue.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会基于你提供的真实证据（如获胜广告、搜索词、客户研究等）产出三个互不重复的广告创意概念卡。每张卡片包含假设、钩子、主要信息、行动号召、视觉简报、成功指标等。它不会捏造数据，也会提醒你核实平台政策。
howto.when: 当你要求做广告文案、创意简报、UGC概念等付费广告创意任务时触发；也适用于分析创意疲劳或提出创意刷新。

say.text: 帮我为这个活动写三个不同的广告创意概念，平台是Meta，受众是25-35岁女性。
say.note: Claude会产出三张概念卡供你审阅。

say.text: 根据这些搜索词和现有广告，提出一个创意刷新假设。
say.note: Claude会从证据出发，输出测试简报。

say.text: 分析这两条广告的创意疲劳，并给出下一轮测试变量。
say.note: Claude会按完整窗口数据诊断后给出建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude creates three distinct ad concept cards from evidence you provide. Each includes hypothesis, hook, message, CTA, visual brief, success metrics. It avoids fabricating data and flags platform-policy checks.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you request paid ad copy, creative briefs, UGC concepts, headlines, creative fatigue analysis, asset ideas, or a creative refresh.

say_en.text: Give me three ad creative concepts for Meta, audience women 25-35.
say_en.note: Claude will output three concept cards for review.

say_en.text: Based on these search terms, propose a creative refresh hypothesis.
say_en.note: Claude will ground the brief in evidence.

say_en.text: Analyze fatigue in these two ads and suggest the next test variable.
